step.title: What should I do if my S1 Pro/T2080 RoboVac has a noise issue?
step.instruction: Regarding the noise issue you encountered, please refer to the following information to determine the type of noise: -If the noise disappears after removing the roller brush and cover, it is likely caused by the roller brush. We can resolve this by sending you a new rolling brush and rolling brush guard. -If the noise persists after removing the roller brush and cover and sounds like a ""chirping"" noise, please try using the mopping mode. If the noise disappears in mopping mode, it is likely caused by the caster wheel hitting the grout lines between tiles. -If the noise persists even after removing the roller brush and cover and using the mopping mode, we will send you a suitable replacement unit. - Please try the suggestions in the article below to see if it works.

We can resolve this by sending you a new rolling brush and rolling brush guard. -If the noise persists after removing the roller brush and cover and sounds like a ""chirping"" noise, please try using the mopping mode. If the noise disappears in mopping mode, it is likely caused by the caster wheel hitting the grout lines between tiles. -If the noise persists even after removing the roller brush and cover and using the mopping mode, we will send you a suitable replacement unit. - Please try the suggestions in the article below to see if it works.
step_cards.expected_result: After this step, check whether the problem is resolved.
